func Run(targetHashHex string)

## Variables

<a name="FixedKey"></a>FixedKey is the 16\-byte Audible magic key used in all hash derivations.

```go
var FixedKey = []byte{
    0x77, 0x21, 0x4d, 0x4b, 0x19, 0x6a, 0x87, 0xcd,
    0x52, 0x00, 0x45, 0xfd, 0x20, 0xa5, 0x1d, 0x67,
}
```

<a name="Audible"></a>
## func [Audible](<https://github.com/kmuchiri/hashbyte/blob/main/hash/hash.go#L14>)

```go
func Audible(candidate uint32, buf1, buf2, buf3 []byte) [20]byte
```

Computes the 3\-pass Audible SHA\-1 derivation for a 4\-byte candidate. It uses pre\-allocated buffers buf1 \(20 bytes\), buf2 \(40 bytes\), buf3 \(32 bytes\) to avoid heap allocations in hot loops.

<a name="NewBuffers"></a>
## func [NewBuffers](<https://github.com/kmuchiri/hashbyte/blob/main/hash/hash.go#L36>)

```go
func NewBuffers() (buf1, buf2, buf3 []byte)
```

NewBuffers creates the 3 pre\-allocated buffers used. The first 16 bytes of buf1 and buf2 are pre\-filled with FixedKey.
